name: The Box
summary:
We are a small, recently founded independent studio, Cibeles Games. This is our first video game: a horror experience based on Catholic theology.

The game offers an unusual approach to the genre, exploring the concept of the devil and the struggle against evil from a perspective consistent with Catholic doctrine. To ensure this approach, the project consulted with priests and also features the participation of a real priest who collaborated by explaining, in one part of the game, what the devil is from the standpoint of Catholic theology.

Step into a chilling first-person point-and-click adventure where the line between faith and madness blurs. As a man of the cloth visiting an old friend in distress, you must unravel the mystery behind her condition. Explore a heavy psychological atmosphere within the walls of a decaying home, where you’ll question every shadow in this homage to 90s cult horror classics. To save a soul, you must first survive the truth.

Through its narrative and gameplay mechanics, the title aims to offer a different kind of horror experience, using the interactive medium to address spiritual and theological questions from a playful perspective.

Not recommended for children under 12.
